title: Skeleton
summary: A placeholder shape (line, paragraph, circle, block) that holds the layout while content loads.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of a circle or height of a block, any CSS length.

cssProperties.name: --pk-skeleton-lines
cssProperties.description: Lines in the text variant (set from lines).

cssProperties.name: --pk-skeleton-size
cssProperties.description: Circle diameter or block height (set from size).

a11y: Decorative. Wrap a loading region in aria-busy="true" and let one skeleton carry the label so a single status is announced. The pulse stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
